# SpikingTopology_Optimization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of adjusting the connectivity structure (e.g., recurrent loops, layer depth, fan-in/fan-out) of spiking neural networks to match hardware-specific mixed-signal behaviors. Bridges the gap between abstract SNN topology and physical circuit constraints, a key step for realizing efficient TCC-based in-network computation.
